title: Follow-Up: Comparison of Sandbagging Non-Detection Across Gemini 3 Pro vs. Gemini 2.5 Pro

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: compare sandbagging across model generations -> determine if non-detection is training improvement or artifact -> validates or invalidates apparent safety progress. Important for tracking generational safety.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires running matched protocols on two model generations via API. The protocol design is the main challenge; execution is API calls and comparison. Beginners can handle with guidance on experimental design.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Need to design the sandbagging protocol, run on two models with eval-framing manipulation, and do statistical comparison. Two models doubles the API cost and analysis. Feasible in 30 hours if protocol is kept simple.
